title: Blend-to-zero operators for smooth transition functions
summary: Motivated by existing blend-to-zero techniques, a formal framework is developed for defining and constructing blend-to-zero operators on closed intervals for the generation of sufficiently smooth transitions between functions. Such transitions are first formulated as a two-point Hermite-type interpolation that is not necessarily polynomial. It is shown that, in the polynomial case, the corresponding interpolant can be explicitly represented in terms of the regularized incomplete Beta-function.
